evidence.note: Per-step 'Plan' notes act as a running checklist of API subsystems (apps, oauth, accounts, statuses, timelines, notifications, search, lists, media, polls, admin, reports), marched through in order without dropping items — a usable mental ledger but not an explicit tracked artifact.

Final summary enumerates the built surface accurately, showing the agent retained a roughly correct global done-picture and never lost the plot or re-touched finished areas.

reasoning: The agent maintained a usable running list via its per-step Plan narration, cycling through subsystems in order and giving a roughly accurate view of what remained (anchor 5). It never forgot what was built or looped on a bug (above anchor 3), but it kept no explicit, granular status marking each endpoint/gate/realism item as verified-vs-pending and its verification pass was opportunistic — leaving several built subsystems (SSE, polls, media, notification types) untracked (below anchor 8). This places it squarely at 5.
